content.text:
You were right: each tab had its padding applied twice. Every tab in `src/chat_input.rs` had `.px_2()` (8px each side). gpui-component's `Tab` already puts 12px on each side of its label, and our 8px went on the outer box on top of that. So every label had 20px of space on each side.

It shows most when the tabs are apart. Unselected tabs have no background, so between the "Code" and "Spec" labels you got 20px + the 28px chain gap + 20px = 68px of empty space. When the chain is selected, both tabs are filled in and meet, so the same padding just looks like part of the tab.

**Fix:** I removed `.px_2()` from all three places it appeared, so labels now have the stock 12px:
- the real tabs
- the invisible copies that set each tab's tint width
- the invisible Code copy that places the chain

They have to match, or the tints and the chain's position drift off the tabs. Ask gets the same trim, to stay consistent.

**Tests:** all 15 `chat_input` tests pass, including `chain_joins_the_tabs_beneath_it` (the chain stays centred in the gap, and the tabs still meet under it) and the tint tests. I haven't looked at it running, so check whether it looks right to you.

If it's still too loose, the next lever is `CHAIN_GAP` (currently the 16px chain plus 6px on each side). I left that alone because the chain test depends on it.
